title: Apothic Renaming
description: An Apotheosis addon that lets you rename affixed items in an anvil without needing the Sigil of Unnaming.
body:
# Apothic Renaming

A server-side mod that lets you rename Apotheosis affixed items in a vanilla anvil. The custom name replaces Apotheosis's prefix/suffix decoration without needing the Sigil of Unnaming. Affixes, sockets, and rarity color stay intact.

## Features

- Rename Apotheosis affixed items in a vanilla anvil.
- Costs 1 level, no materials.
- Affixes stay intact.
- Sockets and gems stay intact.
- Rarity color is preserved on the renamed item.
- Vanilla non-affixed items work like normal in the anvil.
- Sigil of Unnaming still works for users who prefer that route.

## How it works

Put an affixed item in the left slot of a vanilla anvil, type your custom name in the rename field, take the output. The renamed item keeps all its affixes, gems, and rarity color, but displays your custom name instead of the generated Apotheosis name.

The mod is always on when Apotheosis is loaded. No config required.


## Compatibility

Apotheosis 7.x (soft dependency, mod does nothing without it)
